premise: Caterpillar wants to count the little lights of a summer night but can't see past the grass; she climbs up on Mushroom and rears up tall, Firefly's friends glow back one by one — ten little lights to count — and then Mushroom's glittery sneeze adds a hundred more.
inspiration: Counting-rhyme lullabies (Over in the Meadow, folk), turned into a night-sky count that ends in giggles and sleep.
lesson: Friends can lift you up to see the world.

en-US.title: Caterpillar Counts the Lights
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar had heard that summer nights were full of little lights, and she wanted to count them. But down in the grass, she couldn't see a thing. {caterpillar:face sad} Grass, grass, and more grass. Then up popped {mushroom:enter} Mushroom. {mushroom:face happy} [whispers] "Climb up on me." {caterpillar:go on mushroom} Up crawled Caterpillar, {caterpillar:face happy} onto the red cap, and {caterpillar:live look-up hold} reared up tall. [in awe] There was the sky, and the moon, round and bright! But where were the little lights? Sleepy {butterfly:enter} Butterfly came fluttering by. {butterfly:go under mushroom} She tucked herself under Mushroom's cap and {butterfly:live rest hold} folded her wings. Then {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to caterpillar} Firefly came flying over. "Watch," she whispered. {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} She glowed her brightest. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} And all across the meadow, little lights glowed back. [excited] One… two, three… four, five, six… seven, eight, nine… TEN! {mushroom:live sneeze} Then Mushroom sneezed. {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! Glitter everywhere! Eleven? Twelve? A HUNDRED! {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Caterpillar laughed and wiggled all over. [softly] And she {caterpillar:live sleep hold} fell asleep before she got to a hundred and one. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} Firefly waved goodnight. "The lights will be here tomorrow." {canvas:fireflies stop}

es-ES.title: Oruga cuenta las lucecitas
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] {caterpillar:enter} Oruga había oído que las noches de verano se llenan de lucecitas, y quería contarlas. Pero allá abajo, entre la hierba, no veía nada. {caterpillar:face sad} Hierba, hierba y más hierba. Entonces asomó {mushroom:enter} Seta. {mushroom:face happy} [whispers] —Súbete a mí. {caterpillar:go on mushroom} Oruga trepó {caterpillar:face happy} hasta el sombrero rojo y {caterpillar:live look-up hold} se estiró bien alta. [in awe] ¡Allí estaba el cielo, con la luna redonda y brillante! Pero ¿y las lucecitas? {butterfly:enter} Mariposa pasó revoloteando, con mucho sueño. {butterfly:go under mushroom} Se acurrucó bajo el sombrero de Seta y {butterfly:live rest hold} plegó las alas. Entonces llegó volando {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to caterpillar} Luciérnaga. —Mira —susurró. {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} Y brilló con todas sus fuerzas. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Y por todo el prado, otras lucecitas le contestaron. [excited] Una… dos, tres… cuatro, cinco, seis… siete, ocho, nueve… ¡DIEZ! {mushroom:live sneeze} Entonces Seta estornudó. {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! ¡Purpurina por todas partes! ¿Once? ¿Doce? ¡CIEN! {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Oruga se rió y se meneó enterita. [softly] Y {caterpillar:live sleep hold} se quedó dormida antes de llegar a ciento una. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} Luciérnaga le dijo adiós con la patita: —Mañana las lucecitas seguirán aquí. {canvas:fireflies stop}

ja-JP.title: あおむしさん、あかりを かぞえる
ja-JP.text: {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}[softly]{caterpillar:enter}あおむしさんは、なつのよるの小さなあかりを、かぞえてみたかったのです。でも、くさのなかからは見えません。{caterpillar:face sad}くさ、くさ、くさばかり。そこへ、ひょっこり{mushroom:enter}キノコ。{mushroom:face happy}[whispers]「わたしにのぼって。」 {caterpillar:go on mushroom}あおむしさんは、{caterpillar:face happy}赤いかさの上で、{caterpillar:live look-up hold}ぐーん。[in awe]そらと、まあるいおつきさま！でも、あかりは、どこ？ねむたそうな{butterfly:enter}チョウチョさんが、{butterfly:go under mushroom}キノコのかさの下へもぐって、{butterfly:live rest hold}はねをとじました。すると{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to caterpillar}ホタルさんがとんできて、[whispers]「見ててね。」 {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}ぴかーっと、いちばんあかるく。{canvas:fireflies 0.6}はらっぱじゅうで、小さなあかりが、ぴかっとこたえました。[excited]いち…に、さん…し、ご、ろく…しち、はち、きゅう…じゅう！{mushroom:live sneeze}そのとき、キノコがくしゃみ。{sfx:achoo}はっくしょん！キラキラが、いっぱい！じゅういち？じゅうに？ひゃく！{caterpillar:live look-up resume}あおむしさんは、くねくね大わらい。[softly]そして、ひゃくいちまでかぞえないうちに、{caterpillar:live sleep hold}すやすや。{firefly:face happy}{firefly:live wave}ホタルさんが、おやすみとてをふって、「あかりは、あしたもあるよ。」{canvas:fireflies stop}

de-DE.title: Die Raupe zählt die Lichter
de-DE.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] {caterpillar:enter} Die Raupe hatte gehört, dass Sommernächte voller kleiner Lichter sind, und wollte sie zählen. Doch unten im Gras sah sie nichts. {caterpillar:face sad} Nur Gras, Gras, Gras. Da ploppte {mushroom:enter} der Pilz aus dem Boden. {mushroom:face happy} [whispers] „Kletter auf mich.“ {caterpillar:go on mushroom} Die Raupe kroch {caterpillar:face happy} auf den roten Hut und {caterpillar:live look-up hold} reckte sich ganz hoch. [in awe] Da war der Himmel, und der Mond, rund und hell! Aber wo waren die kleinen Lichter? Müde kam {butterfly:enter} der Schmetterling vorbeigeflattert. {butterfly:go under mushroom} Er kuschelte sich unter den Pilzhut und {butterfly:live rest hold} klappte die Flügel zu. Dann kam {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to caterpillar} das Glühwürmchen herbeigeflogen. „Pass auf“, flüsterte es. {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} Es leuchtete, so hell es konnte. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Und überall auf der Wiese leuchteten kleine Lichter zurück. [excited] Eins… zwei, drei… vier, fünf, sechs… sieben, acht, neun… ZEHN! {mushroom:live sneeze} Da nieste der Pilz. {sfx:achoo} HATSCHI! Überall Glitzer! Elf? Zwölf? HUNDERT! {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Die Raupe kringelte sich vor Lachen. [softly] Und {caterpillar:live sleep hold} sie schlief ein, bevor sie bei hunderteins war. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} Das Glühwürmchen winkte gute Nacht. „Die Lichter sind morgen auch noch da.“ {canvas:fireflies stop}

fr-FR.title: Chenille compte les lumières
fr-FR.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] {caterpillar:enter} Chenille voulait compter les petites lumières des nuits d’été. Mais dans l’herbe, elle ne voyait rien. {caterpillar:face sad} De l’herbe, de l’herbe, encore de l’herbe. Alors, hop ! {mushroom:enter} Champignon a surgi. {mushroom:face happy} [whispers] « Grimpe sur moi. » {caterpillar:go on mushroom} Chenille a grimpé {caterpillar:face happy} sur son chapeau rouge et {caterpillar:live look-up hold} s’est dressée bien haut. [in awe] Voilà le ciel, et la lune, ronde et brillante ! Mais où étaient les petites lumières ? {butterfly:enter} Papillon est passé en voletant, tout endormi. {butterfly:go under mushroom} Il s’est blotti sous le chapeau et {butterfly:live rest hold} a replié ses ailes. Puis {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to caterpillar} Luciole est arrivée. « Regarde », a-t-elle chuchoté. {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} Elle a brillé de toutes ses forces. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Et partout dans le pré, d’autres petites lumières ont répondu. [excited] Une… deux, trois… quatre, cinq, six… sept, huit, neuf… DIX ! {mushroom:live sneeze} Alors Champignon a éternué. {sfx:achoo} ATCHOUM ! Des paillettes partout ! Onze ? Douze ? CENT ! {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Chenille a ri en se tortillant. [softly] Et elle {caterpillar:live sleep hold} s’est endormie avant d’arriver à cent un. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} Luciole lui a dit bonne nuit. « Les lumières seront encore là demain. » {canvas:fireflies stop}

it-IT.title: Bruco conta le lucine
it-IT.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] {caterpillar:enter} Bruco aveva sentito dire che le notti d'estate sono piene di lucine, e voleva contarle. Ma giù nell'erba non vedeva proprio niente. {caterpillar:face sad} Erba, erba, e ancora erba. Poi è spuntato {mushroom:enter} Fungo. {mushroom:face happy} [whispers] «Sali su di me.» {caterpillar:go on mushroom} Bruco si è arrampicato {caterpillar:face happy} sul cappello rosso e {caterpillar:live look-up hold} si è alzato bello dritto. [in awe] Ecco il cielo, e la luna, tonda e luminosa! Ma dov'erano le lucine? {butterfly:enter} Farfalla, mezza addormentata, è passata di lì svolazzando. {butterfly:go under mushroom} Si è infilata sotto il cappello di Fungo e {butterfly:live rest hold} ha chiuso le ali. Poi è arrivata in volo {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to caterpillar} Lucciola. «Guarda», ha sussurrato. {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} Si è accesa più forte che poteva. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} E in tutto il prato, tante lucine le hanno risposto. [excited] Una… due, tre… quattro, cinque, sei… sette, otto, nove… DIECI! {mushroom:live sneeze} Poi Fungo ha starnutito. {sfx:achoo} ETCIÙ! Brillantini dappertutto! Undici? Dodici? CENTO! {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Bruco ha riso e si è dimenato tutto. [softly] E {caterpillar:live sleep hold} si è addormentato prima di arrivare a centouno. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} Lucciola lo ha salutato con la zampina: «Buonanotte. Le lucine ci saranno anche domani.» {canvas:fireflies stop}

zh-TW.title: 毛毛蟲數亮光
zh-TW.text: {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}[softly]{caterpillar:enter}毛毛蟲聽說，夏天的晚上有好多好多小亮光，牠好想數一數。可是在草叢裡，牠什麼也看不見。{caterpillar:face sad}草、草，還是草。這時，{mushroom:enter}蘑菇冒了出來。{mushroom:face happy}[whispers]「爬到我身上來。」 {caterpillar:go on mushroom}毛毛蟲爬呀爬，{caterpillar:face happy}爬上紅紅的菇傘，{caterpillar:live look-up hold}把身體抬得高高的。[in awe]天空就在那裡，還有月亮，又圓又亮！可是，小亮光在哪裡呢？{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶睏睏地飛過來。{butterfly:go under mushroom}牠鑽到蘑菇的菇傘底下，{butterfly:live rest hold}合起翅膀。接著，{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to caterpillar}螢火蟲飛了過來。「你看。」 牠小聲說。{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}牠用盡全力，亮出最亮的光。{canvas:fireflies 0.6}整片草地上，一個個小亮光也跟著亮了起來。[excited]一……二、三……四、五、六……七、八、九……十！{mushroom:live sneeze}這時，蘑菇打了個噴嚏。{sfx:achoo}哈啾！亮晶晶的粉飛得到處都是！十一？十二？一百！{caterpillar:live look-up resume}毛毛蟲笑得全身扭來扭去。[softly]還沒數到一百零一，牠就{caterpillar:live sleep hold}睡著了。{firefly:face happy}{firefly:live wave}螢火蟲揮揮小腳，說晚安：「明天，小亮光還會在這裡喔。」 {canvas:fireflies stop}

zh-HK.title: 毛毛蟲數燈仔
zh-HK.text: {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}[softly]{caterpillar:enter}毛毛蟲聽說，夏天的晚上到處都是一點點的小光點，牠很想數一數。可是在草叢裏，牠甚麼也看不見。{caterpillar:face sad}草、草，還是草。這時，{mushroom:enter}蘑菇冒了出來。{mushroom:face happy}[whispers]「爬上嚟我度啦。」 {caterpillar:go on mushroom}毛毛蟲爬呀爬，{caterpillar:face happy}爬上紅色的蘑菇帽，{caterpillar:live look-up hold}把身子挺得高高的。[in awe]天空就在眼前，還有月亮，又圓又亮！可是，小光點在哪裏呢？{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶睡眼惺忪地飛過來。{butterfly:go under mushroom}牠鑽到蘑菇帽下面，{butterfly:live rest hold}合起翅膀。接着，{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to caterpillar}螢火蟲飛了過來。「你睇住。」 牠輕聲說。{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}牠用盡全力，發出最亮的光。{canvas:fireflies 0.6}整片草地上，一點點小光點也跟着亮起來。[excited]一……二、三……四、五、六……七、八、九……十！{mushroom:live sneeze}這時，蘑菇打了個噴嚏。{sfx:achoo}乞嗤！亮晶晶的粉末飛得到處都是！十一？十二？一百！{caterpillar:live look-up resume}毛毛蟲笑得全身扭來扭去。[softly]還沒數到一百零一，牠就{caterpillar:live sleep hold}睡着了。{firefly:face happy}{firefly:live wave}螢火蟲揮揮小腳，說聲晚安：「啲燈仔，聽日都仲喺度㗎。」 {canvas:fireflies stop}

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft sparkly twinkle after it, playful
